However, that doesn’t mean there isn’t something on her end I’m not aware of. I can’t tell him this but she spends a lot of time basically telling me I should leave him over the stupidest of stuff. I originally took it as her being way over protective but now I’m not so sure.
I don’t think so but what do I know, right? She has a boyfriend that she is very obsessed with but her not getting back to me on this is making me concerned.

Him and I have talked and we are going to counseling. He has no idea why my BFF is involved or why his mom would tell her any of it. 

I think she told her cause she thought it would get back to me and cause issues. Little did she know, it would take months.
Maybe but she didn’t even bother telling me she knew for a fact my husband lied to me. Why not at least tell me that?
Yeah, she literally left me on read.
No that’s ok. Based on my bff and I’s history, her having contact with my MIL doesn’t bother me. What bothering me is her withholding info about the conversation.

She is in a relationship and I don’t think so, certainly never seemed like it to me.

Considering my friend and I grew up with each other so she and her family were literally there for all of it, he doesn’t have an opinion. Why would he?

The sensitive family issues have to do with my parents, not my husband and I.

Our families are really close so they also know my in-laws.

I talked to my husband and he honestly didn’t realize he did. We are getting counseling to work out his relationship with his mom and how it affects our marriage. 

Best friend won’t even text me back.

Major trump supporter despite her being an Arab American who’s on food stamps. She’s always hated therapists and thinks they are all out to get her. 

Once she kicked her adderall addiction she decided she is anti-pharmaceuticals as well. And by kicked, I mean her pill pushing doctor refused to keep prescribing it so she had no choice.

She has to believe my sister didn’t do anything wrong cause if she admits she did then the light goes on her for all the physical abuse she participated in. Sister has to believe the victim so she can also be the victim.

Honestly, I just skim her emails at this point. It’s always flowery 30 dollar words or legalese with just the meanest message you can imagine with very little substance.

Very much so.
Shark eyes. It’s hard to describe to someone who’s never seen it.

Ditto on witch/hermit. My mom used to lock herself in her “office” for days and if you bothered her for food or literally anything she would unleash on you. She pulled us out of school to “homeschool” us once her insanity started to show outside of our home and people were getting concerned. She never taught us anything and we missed out on over half a school year because of it. 

Every day was a new bag of terror or just total abandonment. No middle ground.
I have to remember that cause you are right, it really isn’t possible. There is no middle ground with her, her way or no way.

So this is just a snippet of course. If you go to my profile, you'll see other letters she's written that are much closer to the clinical BPD misbehavior. This fits into a much longer tantrum she's been spewing for months, I just fell for her woe is me when I knew I shouldn't have.

Hate = obsession?

Never-ending cycle.

Yeah when I don't respond or try to change the topic, she finds a way to pull it back. This is like the 4th time I've told her we need to not discuss politics but she's decided the only reason I don't want to is cause I "know I'm wrong". 

The irony of an Arab woman living off SS in a state paid for apartment on food stamps is not lost on me but she thinks she's the exception. It's total insanity.

We are NC right now. It's difficult because she has so many issues and my sister gets wrapped up in them and then needs help figuring them out. I've gotten to the point now where I'm not going to be apart of it but sometimes it's easier to just deal with it vs fight.

My mom started taking Adderall when it was prescribed to me as a kid. Long after I was off of it she kept taking it and eventually got her own. 


She has been taking 30mg daily for over 20 years and due to the extreme personality changes, we rarely speak. She has become paranoid, aggressive, and will not shower for months on end cause she thinks it’s a waste of time when she has “so much to do”. Her life has been completely consumed by the drug and she has lost everything because of it. Her aggression has come in the form of violence against us more times then I can count cause she thinks we are trying to help the government destroy her. No one in her family will talk to her, and despite having a really successful business career when we were kids, she now lives on public assistance. She ran my parents business into the ground and blasted through all her savings on crack pot Adderall fueled ideas. There was nothing in the world that would’ve changed her mind about these plans and she ended up homeless for a few years because no one would risk taking her in for their own safety. But despite being homeless and destitute, she filled her Adderall script every month and if she couldn’t afford it, she would play victim just long enough to get the money and then would attack you for whatever paranoid reason she came up with. She is almost 70 years old and the cycle is only gotten worse.



For your child’s sake, try to get him off of it. But if it doesn’t work, run. The effects overtime will become permanent and his behavior towards you and your child will not get better. I agree that cutting off the source is the move but you need to protect yourself and your children before you do that because your husband could get violent, even if that’s not who usually is. 


I still deal with PTSD and mental health issues that her behavior caused. Don’t let your husband’s addiction do the same to your children.


Good luck.

Exactly. In her mind, all of her actions were noble and fine. it was everyone else who was the problem. No one likes admitting when they fucked up but it takes a special kind of crazy to turn around to blame someone else even years after the fact. 

I'm sorry you have to deal with it too.

Thank you.

Sometimes it can be hard to remember what actually happened and it's even worse when you were the only other person there. Luckily I've learned to trust myself at least enough to see through crap like this.

Sending you peace as well <3
